sets.line_watch: {pack} lags a little ({mv} mV cell difference); that usually evens out after the next full charge.
sets.line_high: the cell difference of {pack} is high ({mv} mV). Let the set charge fully once so it can balance the cells.
sets.line_edge: all fine. Near full or empty the cell voltages spread out; that is normal and not judged (*).
sets.offline_line: {sets} is offline; the values are from the last reading.
sets.pack_power_note: Power on the battery side · − = delivering
sets.cell_note: Cell difference = highest minus lowest cell voltage in the battery (the set reports per 10 mV). Only judged between 20 and 90 % SOC: up to 30 mV is good, up to 80 mV watch, above that high. Near full or empty the cells spread out by themselves. The set balances the cells when it is full.
